scope: Decision gate for proceeding from the PyTorch reference checkpoint to a later ONNX validation phase

rationale.overall_test_micro_f1_minimum: Existing project training guidance names 0.90 as the overall F1 floor.
rationale.high_risk_test_recall_minimum: Existing project guidance names 0.95 as the critical-entity recall floor.
rationale.overall_test_macro_f1_minimum: Prevents high-support labels from hiding broad class weakness.
rationale.minimum_individual_label_recall: Prevents a nominal aggregate pass when one canonical class is unusable.
rationale.gretel_test_micro_f1_minimum: Requires meaningful performance beyond SecureLogX generated templates.
rationale.unseen_template_synthetic_micro_f1_minim: Checks generalization to template families held out by construction.
rationale.hard_negative_records_with_false_positiv: Limits pattern-only false alarms; the result remains qualified because test has one hard-negative family.
rationale.alignment: No unexplained failures or truncated entity spans may be hidden. Explicitly tokenizer-unrepresentable frozen annotations remain reported separately.
